title: fix(i18n): a Traditional Chinese session reads and edits the Traditional entry of an inline label map
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKnw5nKcC7y1QqoHK4wxk2W)_

Fixes #30910

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Metadata-protocol is `none` because what an author can write is unchanged: the same `InlineLocaleMapSchema` keys and values are accepted, and only which of two existing entries a Chinese session reads and edits moves.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：内联多语言标签同时写了简体和繁体时，繁体中文会话（zh-Hant / zh-TW / zh-HK）现在读到、编辑的都是繁体那一条；简体会话同理只取简体。客户端 `pickLocalized`（含写入侧 `setLocalized` / `clearLocalized`）和 spec 的 `resolveI18nLabel` 一起改，规则保持一致。
- 为什么改：之前两边都取作者写下的第一个 `zh-*` 键，台湾、香港用户看到简体，在 Studio 里保存还会覆盖简体作者的文字，繁体那条反而不更新。
- 风险与回滚：只影响同一张标签里同时有两种中文书写的情况；只有一种书写的标签、以及所有非中文语言，结果与改前逐字节相同（有测试钉住）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts` 的 `localizedEntryKey`（读写共用的一处）；`packages/spec/src/ui/i18n-label-resolver.ts` 的 `scriptEntryKey`；`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/i18nLabel-resolver-parity.test.ts` 新增的两侧一致性行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/pickLocalized.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 “an entry of the session's own script first” 一组覆盖每种繁简拼写。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- **席位意见**：ui 席 2 对照 head `6e8b6389` 复核：14 个文件、+498 / −65，无受治理路径，因碰 `packages/spec/src` 走 CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER 契约复审：首轮 FAIL（6700222070，Studio 导航设计器的写入键 `ownEntryKey` 仍按旧规则，会在双书写标签上改错条目），修复后 delta 复审 PASS（6700837928），之后只加了一条 changeset（Regen-provenance 已落）。现场：zh-Hant 会话侧栏显示繁体条目。Studio 设计器语言只有 zh-CN / en-US 两值，繁体会话仍按简体设计，已另立 #31074。CI 全绿，同意落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/i18n/src/pickLocalized.ts`: one private `localizedEntryKey` now answers the first three limbs for both `pickLocalized` (read) and `localeWriteKey` (write, and so `setLocalized` / `clearLocalized`). Where the platform locale table splits a language by script, the base and sibling limbs prefer an entry of the session's own script before any other sibling.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/i18n-label-resolver.ts`: `resolveI18nLabel` takes the same limb (`scriptEntryKey`), so the spec twin, which the nav, app shell, components and service-analytics call, keeps agreeing with `pickLocalized` limb for limb.
- **How the script split is derived:** both readings come from `@objectstack/spec/system`, with no local table. `platformLocaleTagOf(code)` says which table tag a code means (`zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-MO` and the `zh-Hant-*` spellings mean `zh-Hant`; `zh`, `zh-CN`, `zh-SG` and the `zh-Hans-*` spellings mean `zh-Hans`). A base is script-split when `PLATFORM_LOCALE_TAGS` holds more than one tag with that base, which today is only `zh`. For any other language the new limb is skipped, so `pt`, `es`, `en`, `fr`, `ja` and the rest keep authoring order on the sibling limb, byte-identical to `main`.
- Limb order where the split applies: exact tag, then the bare base key when it means the session's tag, then the first sibling that means it, then the base key whatever it means, then the first sibling. A map with no entry of the session's script resolves as before.
- Tests: new `describe` blocks in `pickLocalized.test.ts`, `setLocalized.test.ts` and `clearLocalized.test.ts` (five Simplified and five Traditional spellings over six two-script maps, plus byte-identical controls for one-script maps and for `pt`, `es`, `en`, `fr`, `ja`); new rows in the plugin-list parity table; the spec test's verbatim reference copy re-pinned to the new blob and given script vectors.
- Two existing vectors pinned the defect itself (`{ 'zh-TW', 'zh-CN' }` at `zh` read the Traditional entry). Both now expect the Simplified entry. The spec row was replaced by a `pt-PT` / `pt-BR` row that still pins "first sibling in authoring order" for a language the table names once.
- Changesets: `@object-ui/i18n` patch, `@objectstack/spec` patch, `@objectstack/cli` patch.
- Review widening (contract review 6700222070, claim amendment 6700234158): `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.ts` `ownEntryKey` now owns the entry `resolveI18nLabel` reads among the map's same-base own entries, so Studio's nav rename and clear act on the entry the designer shows (`7422324200`); `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-coverage.ts` `inlineLocaleText` narrows to the reader's language and returns what `resolveI18nLabel` picks, with a two-script fixture in `packages/cli/test/i18n-inline-locale-map-coverage.test.ts` (`4b4e003685`); resolver prose follows the limb order and the one-repo home (`2d5cae2c8d`).

## Tests

Fix commit `7228816bf5`, then `origin/main` merged (it carries #30902's `@object-ui/i18n` → `@objectstack/spec` dependency). Suite and gate readings are on the merge head `4d0fb81ba5`. The ablation was taken on `7228816bf5`, where the same two source files hold the same blobs.

<details><summary>Before / after (unit level, read value and write key)</summary>

On `main` `0e882086`:

```
zh-CN+zh-TW        lang=zh-Hant  read=客户  writeKey=zh-CN
zh-Hans+zh-Hant    lang=zh-TW    read=客户  writeKey=zh-Hans
zh-TW+zh-CN        lang=zh-Hans  read=客戶  writeKey=zh-TW
zh-TW+zh-CN        lang=zh       read=客戶  writeKey=zh-TW
spec resolveI18nLabel  zh-CN+zh-TW at zh-Hant  read=客户
```

On this branch the same rows read 客戶 / zh-TW, 客戶 / zh-Hant, 客户 / zh-CN, 客户 / zh-CN, and the spec resolver reads 客戶. These are pinned in the new describe blocks. One-script maps (`zh` only, `zh-HK` only) read and write the same key as on `main`.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/i18n-label-resolver.test.ts src/system/platform-locales.test.ts`: 2 files, 184 tests passed.
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/i18n/src/__tests__/pickLocalized.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/setLocalized.test.ts packages/i18n/src/__tests__/clearLocalized.test.ts packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/i18nLabel-resolver-parity.test.ts scripts/__tests__/check-phantom-dependencies.test.ts`: 5 files, 276 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n type-check` after building its closure: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one-time proof, mutations restored, blob equals HEAD)</summary>

Every leg used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`.

- Client limb (`if (script !== undefined)` changed to never match) in `pickLocalized.ts`: 32 tests red across the three i18n files, all of them new #30910 pins. 0 byte-identical controls red, as expected, because the mutation is the old behaviour.
- Spec limb (`if (sameScript !== undefined) return …` changed to never match), spec source suite: 5 red (4 script vectors plus the one-pass agreement test). The reference-copy column stayed green.
- The same spec mutation, rebuilt into `dist` (`ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 2 built files): 6 red in the plugin-list parity test (5 new rows plus "has no rule divergence left"). After restoring and rebuilding, the preflight `--absent` reports the marker gone from all 592 built files and the tree clean.
</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`, 83 families)</summary>

`--ran` reconciliation on `4d0fb81ba5`: 83 derived, 83 run, all exit 0, 0 NOT-MEASURED.

Before `main` was merged (on `7228816bf5`), `check:undeclared-dep-imports` and the ui `scripts/` phantom-deps test were red only because `@object-ui/i18n` did not yet declare `@objectstack/spec`. #30902 added that declaration, and both are green on the merge head.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Live check (head `6e8b6389`, showcase backend + console dev server, `nav_projects` relabelled locally to `{ en, zh: '简体项目', 'zh-TW': '繁體專案' }`, reverted after):** the sidebar shows 繁體專案 in `zh-Hant`, 简体项目 in `zh-CN`, Proj EN in `en`. Studio's nav designer in a `zh-Hant` session lists 简体项目, because Studio's designer locale is two-valued (`useMetadataLocale`, `metadata-admin/i18n.ts:955`, unchanged here): filed as #31074 with the one-script write and the CLI empty-entry caveat. The main-side control is NOT MEASURED (it needs a `main` spec dist rebuild).
- Case: the script preference asks `platformLocaleTagOf`, which folds case, so `zh-hant` also prefers `zh-TW`. It only reorders keys the case-sensitive base comparison already admitted, so `ZH-HANT` still matches no `zh-*` key (pinned).
- A script-subtag spelling the alias table does not name (`zh-Hant-US`) is not guessed at and is not treated as Traditional (pinned). This matches the spec table's closed-list rule.

## Out of scope

- Finding, not filed: the base-language comparison in both twins is case-sensitive on `main` (`ZH-HANT` matches no `zh-*` key), while the new script limb reads through `platformLocaleTagOf`, which folds case. Folding the base comparison would change matching for every language, so it is outside #30910 and is left for the contract reviewer to weigh.

## Verification

Readings as above, on `4d0fb81ba5`; on `2d5cae2c8d` 87 derived gates exit 0 (`--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED), navItemLabel ablation reds 4 pins and 0 controls, CLI ablation reds 2. `6e8b6389` adds the cli changeset only. The contract review (CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER) on the head is the seat's, because the diff touches `packages/spec/src`.
